messages:
Priya (AE): Quick take — Prospect: Mistral Analytics. Asking for experimental pricing: 20% off month 1, 15% off months 2-3, plus net45 payment terms during pilot. Pilot 90 days, potential annual conversion. PO attached: MISTRAL_PO_0401.pdf
Ethan (DealDesk): Tell me why this is experimental vs standard concession. Do we want tiered discounts or a single lump credit? Need exposure calc.
Priya (AE): They want ramped discounts because they expect usage growth across pilot. Estimated pilot spend at list = $28k total. If converted, ARR projected ~$110k.
Maya (Finance Ops): Tiered discounts ok but harder to track billing automation. Finance can approve up to 20% total concession across pilot (single-line credit). Net45 increases DSO, need AR signoff. Prefer a $3k onboarding credit + 15% off usage cap.
Ethan (DealDesk): Can we propose: $3k onboarding credit + 15% off usage for 90 days, with an additional 5% one-time conversion bonus if they convert to 12 months within 30 days post-pilot? That preserves revenue while giving AE runway.
Priya (AE): Customer prefers the ramp (20/15/15). They insist on net45 during pilot, but ok with net30 after conversion.
Carlos (Legal): If we do net45 we must include a clause: payment default >60 days triggers reversal of credits and immediate invoicing. Also need conversion acceptance criteria (what "convert" means). I can draft both clauses.
Maya (Finance Ops): Ops constraints: prefer single credit line so we can automate. If Deal Desk wants ramped, we need a manual billing exception and an invoice schedule doc. Manual exceptions slow collections.
Ethan (DealDesk): This is a strategic partner pilot; manual exception is acceptable if Finance documents process. Ask: CFO signoff needed for >20% effective discount or net45?
Jane (CFO): I will sign off on a structure that limits our risk. Approve up to 20% effective concession across pilot plus $3k onboarding credit. Net45 allowed only if Legal clawback clause present and customer provides a signed intent to convert (draft term sheet) before pilot starts. Also require PO before any usage credits applied.
Priya (AE): Acknowledged. I'll get the signed intent and the PO. Customer agreed to the conversion term sheet.
Carlos (Legal): Draft clause: "If Customer fails to execute a binding conversion agreement within 90 days of pilot end, Redwood may invoice any credits applied during the pilot and interest at 1.5% monthly until paid." Doc link: //docs/redwood/mistral-clawback-v2
Maya (Finance Ops): BillingBot: flag account for manual billing workflow and prevent automated credit application until PO + signed term sheet received.
BillingBot: Account MISTRAL-001 flagged. Workflow: MANUAL_BILLING_EXCEPTION_CREATED.
Ethan (DealDesk): Summary of ask to approve: $3k onboarding credit + up to 20% effective concession during 90-day pilot. Net45 only after signed conversion intent; otherwise Net30. Legal clawback clause included. Finance Ops to own exposure tracking.
Jane (CFO): Approved per summary. Finance Ops to record exception and update AR playbook. No further discounting without CFO re-approval.
Priya (AE): Great — Ill attach the signed term sheet and PO when received and move to ops for invoice setup. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
